title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-28
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a 1970 show with a crisp Lovelight sandwich, standout Mason's Children and The Other One jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑fidelity soundboard tape that delivers crystal‑clear instrument separation and a superb mix. Musically the show shines thanks to an engaging acoustic interlude, a powerful Lovelight opening/closing sandwich and memorable performances of Mason's Children, The Other One and The Other One. Overall reviewers rave about the set’s variety and energy despite a few noting a lack of sustained momentum after the second‑set jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviews (15+) are strongly positive about both performance and audio quality; recording is praised as excellent, while the show is described as varied and exciting with several standout moments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with superb instrument separation; reviewers note no drop‑outs or muddiness, describing the dynamics and balance as outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A unique set order places Lovelight as a sandwich around an acoustic interlude, creating suspense and contrast; the second half builds energy through Alligator → Drums → The Other One → Mason's Children, delivering strong momentum.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is described as clear, tight and non‑thumpy, standing out in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers receive praise for the Alligator > Drums > Other One sequence and a dynamic drum duo that drives the jams.
